purpose: Two intact grass leaves for independently phased continuous rotation around bottom roots.
importPreparation: Each source half is cropped to alpha bounds, nearest sampled at 18px and 14px height with an eight-pixel minimum width to retain the narrow stem, and mapped to four accepted Tutorial greens with binary alpha. Bottom pivots are centered on the lowest opaque sampled row. Existing MeadowFlowers and Meadow_Reeds are copied pixel-for-pixel from their original atlases into this atlas with bottom pivots.
motion: Rigid continuous quad rotation; no UV deformation, row displacement, pixel snapping or stepped time. Source art remains pixel art.

lowlandsRevision.direction: Slightly shorter blades pointing more upright; Moonshire is inspiration, preserve original Ardan identity.
lowlandsRevision.importPreparation: Crop each half to alpha>=128 bounds; nearest sample at 16/12px heights with seven-pixel minimum width to retain the narrow bottom root; nearest palette mapping and binary alpha; lowest-row root pivots. Copy original flowers/reeds unchanged. Native 16 PPU.
lowlandsRevision.retained: Plant records/density, offsets/phases/flexibility, smooth rotation/cutting/depth and accepted copied flowers/reeds.
lowlandsRevision.review: Imported and agent-inspected at gameplay size; user visual approval pending.
lowlandsRevision.currentScope: Both Tutorial and Green Lowlands use this atlas. Both public leaf-build menus use this recipe.

status: Historical source retained as the edit input for the current Lowlands revision. Old runtime atlas retired 16 October 2026.
